lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho8Tl4Au4 (reduced formula Ho2TlAu) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Au and Tl center has eight Ho neighbors, while each Ho center has four Au and four Tl neighbors, all at 3.0156 Å and described as body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ho-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Au- and Tl-centered polyhedra.
